title: Email automation with calculator and document filing
summary: Rocky can now file email attachments directly from Gmail, has a calculator tool, and sends smarter email digests with only actionable items.

sections.heading: New
items: File PDF attachments directly from Gmail with email-based filing
Property manager email attachments are automatically filed through the document pipeline
Calculator tool that forbids mental arithmetic in all financial calculations

sections.heading: Improved
items: Email digest now only reports emails that need action, filtering out security alerts and Google sign-in notices
Emails are rendered as emoji action indicators with direct Gmail links instead of full summaries

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Protokoll (meeting minutes) are now filed under their meeting year instead of the plan period year

links.label: File property manager attachments in daily email job
Smart email digest with actionable items only
